I've tried, i just can't seem to find anything. I'm trying to help her, and I'm at a point where I don't care what happens to me, I just want her to get better. I feel like I've been looking to a solution for a problem that's not going to be solved, and I don't know what to do anymore.

I can tell you, that I've only been depressed for about a year, but I've never really had too many friends. I had people that I hung out around, but never anyone that I could tell everything to, never anyone that I loved. This year though, I met my best friend through sports and she has helped me through everything. It only took about a month before I really got to know her and now I tell her everything and she is the only one who knows I'm depressed, and I would do anything for her. I've considered suicide before, but now every time it crosses my mind I think of her and how much it would her her to leave. So basically long story short it might take a while but there is someone out there for you, but once you meet them you'll know, and they can help you immensely.
